answer: Locks are recorded in jade, expire in garden, and zephyr lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 166 aliases hence needs 84 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3265 identities would post 1953 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
